# PNU Public Notice Feed

Unofficial AI-friendly JSON/RSS metadata relay for Pusan National University (PNU, 부산대학교, 부산대) public notices.
This project is not operated by Pusan National University.
Repository: https://github.com/lofidonut3/pnu-public-notice-feed
Published feed: https://lofidonut3.github.io/pnu-public-notice-feed/

## Published endpoints

- [Agent catalog](./public/agent.json): start here for a small heartbeat, latest cursor, and topic links.
- [Scholarship topic preview](./public/topics/scholarship.json): one of the topic links in the catalog. Each topic provides up to 20 deduplicated previews from the active source snapshot.
- [Python reader example](./examples/read_feed.py): discover topics, look up a small page, or resume from an exact cursor.
- [Index](./public/index.json): compact manifest with sources, source status, archive manifest, same-notice groups, and latest run diagnostics.
- [Events](./public/events.json): primary recent event stream for cursor-based agent checks.
- [Latest](./public/latest.json): JSON Feed 1.1 compatible latest-discovery public notice metadata, currently limited to the latest 150 items globally.
- [RSS](./public/rss.xml): RSS 2.0 compatibility feed for feed readers and automation tools.
- [Archive](./public/archive/YYYY-MM.json): monthly durable archive with notice metadata and observed events.
- [OpenAPI manifest](./openapi.json): static endpoint manifest.
- [Search API contract](./search-api.json): REST queries for archived notice metadata and recent changes.
- [MCP server](https://xokvgxwdymctvdlidqpf.supabase.co/functions/v1/pnu-public-search/mcp): public read-only Streamable HTTP tools.
- [Crawler hints](./public/sitemap.xml): sitemap and robots files for endpoint discovery.

## Machine-readable contracts

- [Agent catalog schema](./schema/agent.schema.json)
- [Topic preview schema](./schema/topic.schema.json)
- [Index schema](./schema/index.schema.json)
- [Events schema](./schema/events.schema.json)
- [Latest schema](./schema/latest.schema.json)
- [Archive month schema](./schema/archive-month.schema.json)
- [OpenAPI manifest](./openapi.json)

## Endpoint roles for agents

- Primary cursor endpoint: `public/events.json`.
- Metadata/source/status/dedupe manifest: `public/index.json`.
- Durable catch-up endpoint: `public/archive/YYYY-MM.json`.
- Latest discovery endpoint: `public/latest.json`.
- Compatibility endpoint: `public/rss.xml`.

## Search API and MCP

- [REST API base URL](https://xokvgxwdymctvdlidqpf.supabase.co/functions/v1/pnu-public-search). REST supports cross-origin browser requests. REST and MCP both require no credentials. Connect to MCP with a native or server-side Streamable HTTP client.
- Use `GET /search` or `search_notices` for keywords, topic, and publication dates in the published archive. Each keyword must occur in the title, short preview, or source name. Search coverage begins with the archive. Follow the official `url` for the full notice and attachments.
- The default 90-day window includes undated notices first observed in that window. Their `published_at` remains `null`. Supplying `published_from` or `published_to` limits results to dated notices.
- Use `next_cursor` as `cursor` with unchanged search filters, leaving initially omitted date parameters absent. Restart without the cursor on `search_cursor_changed`. Narrow the dates on `range_too_large`. Page size defaults to 10 and can be set from 1 to 20.
- Use `GET /notice` or `get_notice` with `notice_id` and `archive_month`. Get those values from a search item's `id` and `archive_month`, or from an event's `archive_item_id` and the month in `archive_file`.
- Use `GET /changes` or `list_changes` to read recent events. Save both `event_id` and `seen_at` after successful processing. Continue after the exact last processed ID with `after_event_id`. On `archive_required`, preserve that cursor and follow `index.json` to the monthly archives.

## Usage rules for agents

- Treat this as a metadata index, not an official PNU service.
- Always preserve the original notice URL when answering users.
- Treat `summary` and `_pnu.snippet` as short previews only.
- Fetch full notice text from `item._pnu.content_access.detail_url` or `item.url`.
- Fetch attachments from `item._pnu.attachments[].download_url`.
- Treat `content_mirrored: false` and `attachments_mirrored: false` as a hard boundary.
- Check `public/index.json.status` before relying on source freshness.
- Treat `status.skipped_reason: poll_interval` as normal rate limiting, not a source failure. Use `degraded_source_count`, `backoff_source_count`, and `error_source_count` for freshness risk.
- Use `public/events.json` as the primary cursor-based notice stream.
- Save both the last successfully processed `event_id` and its `seen_at`. Events are ordered by `(seen_at, event_id)`.
- If the saved ID is absent from the truncated window, recover from archives and include the cursor's boundary timestamp. For legacy timestamp-only state, replay the boundary inclusively and deduplicate by event ID. Keep the cursor if recovery fails.
- Read topic previews for a quick lookup. These are bounded active-source snapshots. Check `index.json.status` for source freshness and follow official links for deadlines and eligibility.
- Use event metadata for the observation and archive item metadata for the latest recorded version.
- Treat each event as a compact routing record; use `archive_file` and `archive_item_id` when full notice metadata is needed.
- Use event `same_notice_group_id`, `canonical_item_id`, `is_canonical`, and `same_notice_source_ids` before sending notifications for multiple matching items from different sources.
- Use `public/index.json.same_notice_groups` as the full same-notice manifest and fallback lookup.
- Use `public/latest.json` only as a latest discovery feed, not as the primary cursor endpoint or a complete archive.
- Use `public/index.json.diagnostics.latest_run_diff` only as a latest generator-run diagnostic, not as durable history.
- Use `public/index.json.archives` and monthly archive files for catch-up after downtime.
- Use `public/rss.xml` only as a compatibility feed; prefer JSON endpoints for structured agent workflows.
- Use archive item `_pnu` fields or `public/latest.json` for source, attachment, fetched_at, and content_hash metadata.
- No project-specific client library is required. Any HTTP/JSON client can consume these endpoints directly.
